focus-revealed-instruction-not-honored: A field's only instruction is meant to appear when you focus it, but it never shows, is clipped off-screen, vanishes too fast, or needs a mouse hover instead of keyboard focus.
instruction-present-but-contradicts-fiel: A field shows a clear instruction that's actually wrong for what it accepts (says MM/DD/YYYY but wants DD/MM/YYYY), so following it guarantees an error.
icon-only-label-not-widely-understood: A data-entry field's only visible cue is an ambiguous icon or symbol that doesn't make clear what to type, so a sighted user can't tell what input is expected.
group-label-needed-but-absent-generalize: Several related fields each have labels too vague alone (Street, City, Zip), and the group has no overall heading, so you can't tell what the set is for, like billing versus shipping.
instruction-visually-orphaned-from-its-f: A field's instruction text exists but sits far away, in a collapsed panel, or is tiny and low-contrast, so a sighted user doesn't connect it to the field or can't read it.
scope-guard-non-data-entry-controls-need: Buttons, links, and toggles aren't data-entry fields, so they correctly need no input instructions and shouldn't be flagged for lacking them.
